scope: C1 Qwen3.8 27B Q4/Q8 targets with Q4_K_M, Q8_0 and BF16 DFlash2 drafts. Fixed seven proposals; no precision, distribution, controller or allocation change.
retained: Batch consecutive online attention queries with the scalar reduction order and causal endpoint.
Batch split-K queries using idle weight-dequantization scratch; preserve scalar fallback for threshold straddles and insufficient scratch.
Use existing batched QK normalization/RoPE/KV-write in verification.
Dispatch Q8_0 48x5120 SSM controls across independent token rows; keep large projection geometry.

operator_checks: Existing canonical KV/snapshot test now checks exact consecutive queries with FP16/FP32 caches, gated/ungated, widths 1/3/8, 4K boundary and reduced scratch capacity.
Existing Q8 GEMV test adds 48x5120 and checks all widths 1..8 against decode.

microbenchmark_scope: Production template probes; each candidate must be byte-exact before timing. Component costs are not model throughput. Narrow GEMM rotates a 128 MiB weight working set.

release_chat.workload: cpp_ring_buffer chat, 128 generated tokens, fixed seven proposals, two interleaved repetitions; timing includes prompt processing. Short development probe, not a full corpus or depth sweep.

release_pp2048_tg128_depth0.workload: Final release measurements: C1, pp2048, tg128, depth0. One timed repetition after warmup for each of the six pairings; every token trace must equal prior qualified AR. Throughput comparison uses the separate interleaved chat probe. Not a depth sweep or variance estimate.

release_pp2048_tg128_depth4096.workload: Short release A/B: C1, pp2048, tg128, depth4096 only, Q4 draft with both targets. One timed repetition after warmup per invocation; alternate release order across pairings. Every baseline/candidate speculative trace must equal prior qualified AR token IDs. Not a depth sweep or variance estimate.

profiles.workload: One diagnostic profile per target, Q4_K_M draft, cpp_ring_buffer chat, 128 tokens. TG begins at the first draft embedding; excludes initial prefill and draft injection. Executors are separated by HIP stream. Profile timings are not throughput estimates.

Prefill has no material gain. C>1 and MTP qualification, original target-source comparison and controller experiments remain separate work.
